parsed.name: UDP数值广播组件
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件通信组件，通过 UDP 在本地网络中广播数值数据，供实验系统中的其他程序或节点接收。适用于实验过程中的实时数据分发、跨进程参数共享和轻量级网络发布。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software communication component that broadcasts value data over UDP on a local network for other programs or nodes in an experimental system to receive. It is suitable for real-time data distribution, inter-process parameter sharing, and lightweight network publishing in laboratory workflows.

actions.description: 广播给定的数值数据到本地网络。
actions.description_en: Broadcast the provided value data to the local network.

actions.description: 关闭该 UDP 广播组件。
actions.description_en: Shut down the UDP publishing component.
